Question Choices: The prism has: 2 layers and each layer has 15 cubes. How many cubes are there in total?
Each small cube has side length 1/3 ft. What is the volume of ONE cube? Put the answer without units
Solution: Volume = length × width × height. In a cube, length = width = height. So volume = (1/3) x (1/3) x (1/3) = 1/27 cubic feet
